topic.label: UI and Front-End Development
topic.desc: Building what people see in a browser: HTML, CSS and layout, components and frameworks, accessibility, browser testing and building websites.

concepts: Page structure and styling: semantic HTML, CSS, flexbox and grid layout, responsive design and theming.
UI components, state in the browser, and frameworks such as React, Vue and Svelte.
Making interfaces usable by everyone: WCAG, keyboard access, screen readers, contrast and focus.
Testing web front ends in real browsers: end-to-end tests, visual checks and console errors.
Building a website or web app end to end: pages, content, routing, build tools, performance and where it is deployed.
skills: Builds a responsive page layout in HTML and CSS that works from phone to desktop width.
Finds why an element is positioned or styled wrongly and gives the minimal CSS fix.
Designs a reusable UI component with its props, states and events.
Compares front-end frameworks for a project by size, ecosystem and rendering model.
Audits a page against WCAG 2.1 AA and lists each failure with its fix.
Writes end-to-end browser tests for a user flow with assertions on what the user sees.
Triages browser console and network errors on a page and names the cause.
Plans and builds a website: pages, navigation, content, build tooling and deploy target.
Audits a website's load performance and lists the largest wins.
mcp: Microsoft Playwright MCP server: drive a browser through accessibility snapshots, navigate pages, click, fill forms and test web front ends.
Chrome DevTools MCP server: inspect a live Chrome page, console, network requests, performance traces and front-end debugging.
